Android Background & Security Limits: Detection runs immediately while PandaNex is open with the screen on. When minimized, enable the Active Background Gesture Service below; on Android 10+, background apps cannot silently force-open Activities, so PandaNex posts an instant tap-to-open Camera prompt if direct launch is restricted. When the screen is off or locked, Android suspends non-system motion sensors to save battery and enforces lock-screen security.

Allows PandaNex to turn off and lock the display when Put Down to Sleep detects that your phone has been placed stably on a flat surface. PandaNex only requests the screen-lock privilege and never modifies passwords or erases data.
Automatically wakes the display when you lift your phone from a resting surface while respecting lock-screen security.
Silences an incoming call ringtone when you lift the ringing phone without declining or disconnecting the call.
Answers an incoming ringing call when you lift the phone upright to your ear, pausing automatically when Bluetooth or car audio is active.
Turns off or locks the display when you place the phone stably screen-up or screen-down on a flat surface after handheld use.
Applies a configurable 10%–90% privacy dimming overlay for selected apps and restores normal brightness automatically on exit.
